test_title: PYST 27: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to substitute the underlined word segment in the given sentence.

If the two families could __forget their past quarrels__ forever, both could benefit immensely.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"bury the hatchet"** means to forget past quarrels and become friendly. (झगड़े को भूलकर दोस्ती करना) • **Example:** After years of rivalry, the two companies finally decided to **bury the hatchet** and collaborate on a new project. • **"Cut to the quick"** refers to deeply hurting someone's feelings. (किसी की भावनाओं को गहराई से आहत करना) • **Example:** His harsh words **cut her to the quick**. • **"Catch a tartar"** means to encounter or deal with a person who is unexpectedly difficult or strong. (किसी मुश्किल व्यक्ति से टकराना) • **Example:** He thought he could easily win the debate, but he **caught a tartar** in his opponent. • **"Do a good turn"** means to do something helpful for someone. (किसी के लिए एक अच्छा काम करना) • **Example:** She** did me a good turn** by lending me her notes before the exam. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Cut to the quick** (किसी की भावनाओं को गहराई से आहत करना): • **Example:** His harsh words cut her to the quick. • **Catch a tartar** (किसी मुश्किल व्यक्ति से टकराना): • **Example:** He thought he could easily win the debate, but he caught a tartar in his opponent. • **Do a good turn** (किसी के लिए एक अच्छा काम करना): • **Example:** She did me a good turn by lending me her notes before the exam. 3e:Tcf2, The correct answer is **Option 3**.
